title: Speedy Gonzales in Los Gatos Bandidos
description: Based off the popular Looney Toons cartoon, Los Gatos Bandidos features side scrolling levels in which players run around at high speeds in a fashion similar to the Sonic series, rescuing mice brethren that have been captured by cats.
